title: Chapter 484 - 484 Playing; Feeling Ashamed!
content:
Chapter 484 - 484 Playing; Feeling Ashamed!

Chapter 484 - 484 Playing; Feeling Ashamed!

484 Playing; Feeling Ashamed!

The first step, which was to leave an impression, had been achieved!

Huo Qilong began to formulate the second step of his plan in his mind to deepen her impression of him.

Soon, he had an idea.

He was about to speak.

“Yunyue, do you like to listen to piano music?” Lin Fan asked.

Chu Yunyue seemed to have thought of something and nodded with a smile.

Lin Fan said, “Alright, I’ll play the piano for you.”

After saying that, he walked straight to the piano not far away.

When Huo Qilong saw this, he was stunned for a moment.

Then, a smile appeared on his face as if he was watching a good show.

At first, he only wanted to leave an impression in Chu Yunyue’s heart.

Who would have thought that Lin Fan would really go play the piano?

He could almost see Lin Fan being a mess and getting laughed at.

At that time, he would definitely occupy an even more important position in Chu Yunyue’s heart.

As for the fact that Lin Fan’s playing was better than his, Huo Qilong did not even consider it.

He had won an award for playing the piano back then.

Besides, the crowd had given him warm applause and Chu Yunyue had even stared at him when he played the piano.

Huo Qilong smiled and said to Chu Yunyue, “So, your name is Yunyue. What a nice name.

“Look at me, I haven’t introduced myself to you yet. I’m Huo Qilong. Nice to meet you.”

After saying that, he took the initiative to extend his right hand.

However, Chu Yunyue acted as if she did not see it. She just stared at Lin Fan with her beautiful eyes, her face full of anticipation.

She had heard Lin Fan sing before and knew that he had great musical ability.

She believed that Lin Fan would definitely be able to play a beautiful piece of music.

This was something he was specially playing for her!

…

Finally, Lin Fan sat in front of the piano.

A wave of discussion broke out around them.

“Huh? Someone wants to play the piano again.”

“I wonder what song he’ll play.”

“Let’s hear it.”

…

Lin Fan did not care about Huo Qilong’s thoughts at all, nor did he care about the discussions of the crowd.

He slowly closed his eyes and placed his hands on the black and white keys.

Instantly…

The rapid, light, and gentle notes rippled.

The people who were still laughing, discussing, and chatting all stopped what they were doing and focused their attention.

They all swayed along with the music.

Even though the spot where Lin Fan was was rather dark, in everyone’s eyes, it was as if a dazzling stage light had appeared above his head. It illuminated him to the point of being incomparably gorgeous.

As the notes continued to play, Lin Fan’s body seemed to emit starlight.

More and more starlight appeared… It circled around Lin Fan.

In the end, it formed a strong traction force that carried Lin Fan and the piano into the air.

When it reached the night sky, the starlight condensed into a crescent moon, emitting an even more dazzling light.

Gorgeous and charming!

Everyone had expressions of admiration and enjoyment that were difficult to hide.

Finally, the last note fell.

The entire bonfire party was still silent.

After a long time, there was extremely enthusiastic applause.

“The melody was so good!”

“That’s Moonlight.”

“This is the first time I’ve heard such a beautiful rendition of Moonlight!”

“It’s even better than symphonies.”

Exclamations, shouts, and screams echoed throughout the entire venue.

Lin Fan did not care too much about it.

He left the piano and strolled to Chu Yunyue, who had been staring at him without blinking.

Then, he slowly held her slender and fair hand.

Under everyone’s watchful eyes, Lin Fan’s head kept getting closer and closer to Chu Yunyue.

Their lips met.

Suddenly, a stage light appeared in the sky and fell on Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue.

Dazzling!

This talented man matched this beautiful woman perfectly!

Once again, the place erupted with extremely enthusiastic cheers and shouts.

In fact, when Chu Yunyue arrived at the bonfire party, it was not only Huo Qilong who noticed her.

There were also many men who thought they were qualified enough to woo her.

Chu Yunyue was simply too beautiful.

However, at this moment, they threw this thought aside.

They knew that they could not win against Lin Fan.

In other words, they felt ashamed in front of Lin Fan.

…

After a long time, their lips parted.

Lin Fan turned around slowly and looked at Huo Qilong. “You’re right. I have to play the piano more for Yunyue in the future.”

Huo Qilong’s face turned red.

Originally, he wanted to use the piano to step on Lin Fan and at the same time get closer to Chu Yunyue.

Now, he had made Lin Fan into a star.

He had shot himself in the foot!

It hurt!

It hurt!

Huo Qilong grunted in response, then turned around and walked away.

At this moment, loud music sounded at the bonfire party.

A group of quick-witted staff members led the crowd to sing and dance, making the atmosphere even more lively.

In addition, there were some programs that had been prepared long ago, various interesting games, as well as drinks and barbecued meat that could be ordered at any time…

Everyone was having a great time.

When Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue returned to the luxury island, it was already midnight.

Perhaps she was too tired from playing, Chu Yunyue accidentally fell into the spacious and clear swimming pool in front of the villa.

Since she had already fallen into the swimming pool, she might as well enjoy her time in it.

She kept splashing water on Lin Fan and laughed.

Lin Fan chuckled. “You’re even messing around with me!”

After saying that, Lin Fan jumped into the swimming pool.

“Ah!”

Thus, the two of them began to chase each other in the swimming pool.

Laughter and shouts rose and fell.

The two of them played in the swimming pool for about half an hour before they slowly got up.

After all, the swimming pool was a little cold at night.

After washing up, an alluring fragrance gradually filled the air.

When Chu Yunyue came out of the bathroom wrapped in an LV towel, her beautiful eyes fell on Lin Fan.

In her mind, she could not help but recall Lin Fan’s elegant and serious movements when he played the piano.

Perhaps it was because she had just walked out of the bathroom, a blush gradually appeared on her pretty face.

Then, Chu Yunyue could not help but slowly approach Lin Fan.

Under the illumination of the light, the two shadows finally merged together.

…

At this moment, the TV in the living room suddenly started playing a song.

The sea breeze gently blew, and the waves gently swayed…
